content.text: {"reachable": true, "rationale": "The only deployed defence is patched_fileserver, and no technique requires NOT patched_fileserver, so it blocks nothing. All other defence constants (segmented, mfa_user, mfa_admin, mfa_dbadmin, patched_workstation, patched_appserver and so on) stay false. One working chain: (1) phish_workstation (always available) gives foothold_workstation and stolen_user. (2) pivot_internal works because there is a foothold and segmented is false, giving reach_internal. (3) auth_appserver works with reach_internal, stolen_user and mfa_user false, giving foothold_appserver. (4) kerberoast_dc works with reach_internal and foothold_appserver, giving stolen_admin. (5) auth_dc works with reach_internal, stolen_admin and mfa_admin false, giving foothold_dc. (6) escalate_dc works with foothold_dc and stolen_admin, giving admin_dc. (7) dump_dbadmin_dc gives stolen_dbadmin. (8) auth_db works with reach_internal, stolen_dbadmin and mfa_dbadmin false, giving foothold_db. (9) escalate_db works with foothold_db and admin_dc, giving admin_db. (10) exfiltrate_db gives exfiltrated. The fileserver route (auth_fileserver, then escalate_fileserver, then exfiltrate_fileserver) is also not blocked by the patch."}
